title.narrative: Improved coherence in support and action to facilitate just transitions towards environmentally sustainable economies and societies

description.narrative: The transition towards environmentally sustainable economies and societies presents significant opportunities to create decent work, reduce inequalities and advance social justice. Realizing these opportunities, while addressing potential challenges affecting labour markets, requires integrated policies that maximize the economic and social benefits of environmental action while ensuring that the transition is fair, inclusive and leaves no one behind. Integrated policies developed through social dialogue, with the active engagement of employers' and workers' organizations, that cut across sectors and policy areas and are supported by adequate financing, are essential to unlock these opportunities and promote a just transition for all. Office-wide coordination will support the implementation of the strategy and action plan to give effect to the Resolution concerning a just transition towards environmentally sustainable economies and societies for all, adopted at the 111th Session (2023) of the International Labour Conference, while further positioning the Just Transition Guidelines as the global reference framework for policymaking. Particular attention will be given to advancing policy responses on issues that affect the world of work, such as (i) heat stress in the workplace, and the promotion of decent work in the following contexts: (ii) the green, blue and circular economies (iii) critical energy transition minerals; (iv) the fight against plastic pollution, (v) land and ecosystem restoration, and (vi) NDC implementation. Support will also be provided to Member States to integrate just transition principles across national policies, strengthening policy coherence and accelerating the implementation of inclusive and effective just transition strategies.
